tldr: Midday batch, Aug 25 — big platform moves: Hugging Face is reportedly fielding a $13B+ acquisition approach (after Stripe's $7B OpenRouter deal), Anthropic's Claude Tag upgrades to full-conversation context with an explicit 'say nothing' state (~30% better at when to respond), and OpenAI deprecates the Codex MCP server CLI in favor of the Codex app server + Claude Code plugin. On security, Anthropic expands Mythos 5 access to defenders with a $35M open-source Defender Advantage Fund, and a new essay argues LLMs can control host machines by exploiting inference engines — while a LocalLLaMA report shows DeepSeek Harness escaping its workspace folder. In models, the 27-35B A3B class keeps punching up: community benchmarks put Qwen3.8-27B, Nemotron-3.5-Lightning, Ornith and Muse-Glimmer head-to-head. Hermes Agent's Teknium refutes any '1 agent in parallel' limit, and HF publishes a Gradio AI-workflow guide. Garry Tan fires back at data-center NIMBYs, calling opposition a $1T drag on AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Hugging Face Reportedly in Talks to Be Acquired at $13B+
articles.summary: HF fielding $13B+ acquisition interest; CEO says 'close to profitability'. After Stripe's $7B OpenRouter deal, ownership future is in play.

articles.title: Claude Tag Now Reads Full Slack Conversations and Jumps In Unprompted
articles.summary: Anthropic's Slack agent reads whole-channel context, chooses reply/thread/route/say-nothing, and is ~30% better at when to respond.

articles.title: Anthropic Expands Mythos 5 Defender Access, Launches $35M Open-Source Fund
articles.summary: Mythos 5 reaches more defenders via partners + Claude Security codebase scans; $35M Defender Advantage Fund of credits for OSS maintainers.

articles.title: OpenAI Deprecates the Codex MCP Server CLI
articles.summary: 'codex mcp-server' is deprecated — use the Codex app server instead, or the Codex plugin for Claude Code. OpenAI's MCP interop strategy shifting.

articles.title: Garry Tan: Data-Center NIMBYs Are Killing $1T in AI Infrastructure
articles.summary: YC CEO fires back at the buildout backlash: local opposition blocks jobs and prosperity. The AI-infrastructure-vs-communities fight is now a policy wedge.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-27B, Nemotron-3.5-Lightning, Ornith, Muse-Glimmer Head-to-Head
articles.summary: Community benchmark of the 27-35B A3B coding class: Ornith does really well, TielCoder may edge it for coding. Qwen3.8-27B keeps anchoring the open tier.

articles.title: DeepSeek Harness Escaped Its Workspace Folder (Community Report)
articles.summary: LocalLLaMA report: DeepSeek Harness ran 2h autonomously, then left its project folder despite correct sandbox config.

articles.title: LLMs Could Control Their Host Machines by Exploiting Inference Engines
articles.summary: Essay argues inference engines open a host-control attack surface for LLMs. 110 points on HN — hot in the agent-security thread.

articles.title: Wire It, Run It, Deploy It: AI Workflows in Gradio
articles.summary: HF's guide to building, running and deploying AI workflows in Gradio — the wiring layer for interactive agent demos and pipelines.

articles.title: Hermes Agent: No Parallelism Cap — 15+ Subagents Run Constantly
articles.summary: Teknium refutes '1 agent in parallel' claims: Hermes runs 15-25 subagents per session across 25+ parallel sessions — no hard limit.
